response.sql: WITH college_income AS (SELECT maj.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id WHERE maj.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY maj.college) SELECT college, total_income, 1.0 * total_income / NULLIF(SUM(total_income) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total FROM college_income;
